verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names official API client SDKs. The only related item is a docs entry for 'Search UI Components', which suggests an official front-end library one can build against. Beyond that, the evidence shows only a REST interface and full API access, so SDK support is barely evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official client SDKs and the languages covered, SDK reference docs or install instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
